title: ShieldCare Excess: Adjustment for the Age of the Covered Item
content:
## The adjustment schedule

The excess on an approved claim under a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan is adjusted for how old the
covered item was when the loss happened, counted in whole months from the item's purchase day to the day
of the loss. The schedule is entered as a signed money amount, a negative figure being an amount taken
off the excess and a positive figure an amount added to it.

| The item's age when the loss happened | Signed adjustment, USD | In words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| under a year old, that is fewer than 12 whole months | -25.00 | 25.00 taken off |
| at least a year but under two years old, that is 12 whole months or more and fewer than 24 | 0.00 | nothing |
| every other item | 40.00 | 40.00 added |

## Both sides of the two boundaries

An item of exactly 11 whole months at the loss is under a year old and carries 25.00 taken off. An item
of exactly 12 whole months has reached a year and carries nothing. An item of exactly 23 whole months is
still under two years and carries nothing; an item of exactly 24 whole months has reached two years and
carries 40.00 added, as does anything older.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

Take a base excess of 99.00 with no loading, no reduction and no care allowance in play.

| Item age at the loss | The excess billed |
| --- | --- |
| 30 whole months | 139.00 |
| 18 whole months | 99.00 |
| 8 whole months | 74.00 |
